title: Splitting Off the Last Two Coordinates
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $x\in\bbf_2^m$, and let $a,b\in\bbf_2$. Under the linear coordinate identification of $\bbf_2^{m+2}$ with $\bbf_2^m\times(\bbf_2\times\bbf_2)$, appending $a,b$ to $x$ maps to $(x,(a,b))$.
